title: Magnolia (bc30)
synopsis: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story. Through coincidence, human action, and divine intervention, their lives weave and warp toward an unforgettable climax. Following Boogie Nights, Paul Thomas Anderson reached new heights with his third feature, winning the Golden Bear at Berlinale.

Through coincidence, human action, and divine intervention, their lives weave and warp toward an unforgettable climax. synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 打開電視人人都能看到溝女導師麥奇，但最渴望見其真人的是他垂死的老父。另一邊廂，老人的年輕妻子婚後多年才頓覺自己深愛對方，為從前貪圖對方家財而責備自己，企圖一死了之。在天才兒童問答比賽中，小天才表現失準，連主持人也因癌症復發而當場暈倒。一位曾參與這節目的中年過氣天才，自嘆無愛情無事業，是天才又有何用。九個人各有自己的生活卻又環環相扣 ，共同構建出一幅都市眾生相。保羅湯瑪士安德遜繼《一舉成名》後再創高峰，憑第三部長片奪得柏林影展金熊獎，至今依然佳作連連。

cast: Tom Cruise, Julianne Moore, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Jason Robards
